scope: Prototype grounding sources for the missed-connection workflow

rules.claim: For a saver fare with train binding, train binding is lifted when a DB-caused connection is missed, subject to the applicable ticket and journey conditions.
rules.sourceTitle: In welchen Fällen ist die Zugbindung aufgehoben und was bedeutet das?
rules.reviewStatus: product-reviewed; legal review required before production

rules.claim: At an expected destination delay of at least 20 minutes for a national journey or 60 minutes for an international journey, qualifying passengers may continue on another eligible train.
rules.sourceTitle: Ihre Rechte als Fahrgast im Eisenbahnverkehr
rules.reviewStatus: product-reviewed; legal review required before production

rules.claim: Compensation is 25% of the applicable one-way fare from 60 minutes of actual destination delay and 50% from 120 minutes, subject to DB passenger-rights conditions.
rules.sourceTitle: Ihre Rechte als Fahrgast im Eisenbahnverkehr
rules.reviewStatus: product-reviewed; legal review required before production

groundingContract.fact: Must include the provider response and retrieval timestamp.
groundingContract.calculation: Must expose named inputs and deterministic formula.
groundingContract.policyClaim: Must reference a versioned rule ID and source.
groundingContract.alternative assessment: Must state assumptions, alternatives considered, and confidence.
groundingContract.failure: Missing, stale, or conflicting evidence must stop automation and trigger review.
